title: Cross-lingual Transfer of Reward Models in Multilingual Alignment
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical performance and cross-lingual transferability of reward models for LLM alignment. While it utilizes safety-related datasets and benchmarks (like SafeRLHF and the 'Safety' category in RewardBench), it treats these as general metrics for reward model accuracy across languages rather than investigating religion, specific moral frameworks, or ethics.
